metaDescription: Shopify store for Master MoltyFoam, a Pakistani mattress brand: sub-brand menus, a mattress selector, warranty activation and pay-in-three checkout.
summary: Shopify store for a Pakistani mattress brand selling mattresses, pillows and sleep accessories.
overview: Master MoltyFoam sells foam and spring mattresses, pillows, cushions, toppers and baby and maternity products, and calls itself Pakistan's No.1 sleep specialists. Its range is split across sub-brands such as Celeste, MoltyOrtho, Be by MoltyFoam, MoltyMom and MoltyBaby. We built the brand's Shopify store to sell that range online and support owners after the sale.
challenge: A mattress is a considered purchase: shoppers compare firmness, support and price, and often want advice before paying. The store also has to serve existing customers who need to activate a warranty, find a store or book a visit, not just new buyers.
approach: An icon menu across the header lists each sub-brand and range, from MoltyFoam and Celeste to pillows, accessories, MoltyMom and MoltyBaby. The home page introduces each sub-brand with a short description tile, then shows best sellers and suggestions with ratings. Product pages keep price, quantity, add to cart and BaadMay pay-in-three in a bar at the top, with buttons to order on WhatsApp, call or email, while utility links cover a mattress selector, warranty activation, store locator and appointment booking.
outcome: A store that sells mattresses and accessories online and also handles the questions around them, from choosing a mattress to activating a warranty or booking a consultation.

process.title: Sub-brands up front
process.body: Each sub-brand and range gets an icon in the main menu and a description tile on the home page, so shoppers can tell Celeste, MoltyFoam and MoltyOrtho apart before they browse.

process.title: Choosing a mattress
process.body: A mattress selector, wedding bundles, a MoltyOrtho consultation booking and ratings on product cards help shoppers narrow the range before they buy.

process.title: Product pages
process.body: Price, quantity, add to cart and BaadMay pay-in-three stay in a bar at the top, with stock status, ratings, a full description and buttons to order on WhatsApp, call or email.

process.title: After the sale
process.body: Footer and header links cover warranty activation, order tracking, store locator, complaint and feedback forms, dealer sign-up and an at-your-door service.

whyItMatters: Mattress buyers rarely decide on price alone, and many want to talk to someone first. A store that answers questions, offers direct contact and supports warranty and service turns a hesitant visit into an order.

faqs.q: What platform is the Master MoltyFoam store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with the Avone OS 2.0 theme, using Shopify collections for each sub-brand and range, BaadMay for installments and WhatsApp for direct orders.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and build Shopify stores for considered purchases, including product selectors, service and warranty pages and installment payments. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
